claims.text: The deviation is established on this trip's own trace. Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, and it reads 18.2 km against the booked optimal of 14.0 km stored on the trip record — an excess of 4.2 km, or 30.0% of optimal. Both establishment gates pass: the excess exceeds 20% of optimal and exceeds 0.8 km absolute. I do not rely on trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test, because POL-RD-01 forbids citing the rounded convenience copy; it agrees at 18.2 km in any event. Disclosure: the GPS trace is impaired, weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged and the burden has shifted. (a) Identity: trip_id TRP-02849 appears on the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown, and the trip record's 'trip_started' event at 07:51:59 matches the trace's first fix at 07:51:59. (b) Threshold: the excess of 4.2 km / 30.0% meets POL-RD-01, measured from a trace that is not impaired at policy level. The extra-corroboration condition in POL-RD-08 is not engaged either: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0, well below the 4-or-more threshold, so no source beyond the trace is required — and that field is cited only for the test POL-RD-08 names, as POL-GEN-01 requires. Disclosure: the GPS trace carries weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW.

The pre-pass impairment of the trace does not reach POL-RD-07. The only gap runs 40.0 seconds, from 08:00:59 to 08:01:39, with 0.4 km between the bounding fixes, and sampling is a steady 10 seconds against an expected 10 seconds — every figure sits below the clause's limbs: no gap over 90 s, no straight-line jump over 500 m, no sustained interval over 30 s. The trace is therefore NOT impaired for policy purposes, and no independent source of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names is needed to establish the excess. The admissibility tag IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 (issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW) is, under POL-GEN-02, a discount on confidence only — the schema-level and policy-level tests are different tests and this artifact fails only the first.

The driver's only answer — 'Navigation rerouted me.' — is a bare assertion with no artifact behind it. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02849-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that impairment — its absence is precisely the point. POL-RD-03 requires an advisory naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses, carrying an overlapping validity window and matched by a route that leaves the corridor before the affected segment and rejoins after; with no advisory in the bundle that comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight. Because the driver names no advisory identifier at all, this is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged; by POL-RD-13 the deviation stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

Nothing in this record supports a rider-requested detour, so POL-RD-04 cannot excuse any part of the excess. The chat log for this trip carries 0 messages: there is no rider instruction, no timestamp before the vehicle left the optimal corridor, and no chat_message.waypoint_hint for the 200 m corroboration test to run on. The clause's own test is undecidable on this record and therefore cannot be satisfied; no distance is excluded before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied.

No endpoint was relocated. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, original_pickup and original_dropoff are both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km is null on the trip record, so POL-RD-05 has no amended re-quote to re-apply and no distance is driven against an amended point. The baseline stays at the booked 14.0 km.

This is not a pooled itinerary. trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and there is no co-rider collection or set-down distance to exclude from the excess.

The fare model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so the trip was not sold at an upfront quote: POL-RD-11 does not run and no distance-or-time refund route is closed to the rider. The remedy is the POL-RD-02 recomputation.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 14.0 optimal km + 0.28 × 19.0 optimal min) × 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 fixed surcharges + 0 waiting time − 0 promo = 20.42. To the rider: your dispute is upheld in part. The governing distance field under POL-RD-01 is the trace figure, and EV-GPS-02849 records 18.2 km between the recorded pickup and drop-off against a booked optimal of 14.0 km on EV-TRIP-02849. The excess is 4.2 km, or 30.0% of optimal, so both establishment tests in POL-RD-01 pass (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%) and a route deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not a MATERIAL deviation: 4.2 km is below the 8.0 km limb and 30.0% is below the 50% limb. The driver-profile check therefore decides nothing for you either way, and in any event it shows no repeat pattern: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 201 completed trips in 90 days, so the POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift and the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral cannot attach. No rider-requested detour exists (the chat log EV-CHAT-02849 holds 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 has nothing to run on), no endpoint was amended (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, so POL-RD-05 does not run), the vehicle type is RYDE_X and not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12 does not run), and the fare model is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null (POL-RD-11 does not run).

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not discretionary. recomputed_fare = (base 3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 optimal km = 10.50 + 0.28 x 19.0 optimal min = 5.32) = 19.62, times the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (the only artifact carrying that field), plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, toll, surcharge, waiting-time or promo line = 20.42. charged_total is 26.73.
